OK so the key insight is to use momentum-based SGD instead of vanilla GD. The loss surface has a lot of saddle points.
Oh! That makes so much sense. I was using plain batch GD and wondering why it wasn't converging.
Karthik you're a lifesaver! Let me try that right now.
Happy to help! We're all in this together 🙌
